As illustrated in Figure 4.5, employee compensation in manufacturing, which includes benefits, has had a five-year compound annual growth of -1.2 %. While manufacturing compensation has had a negative trend, that of private industry has had a positive trend with a five-year compound annual growth rate of 0.8 %. Hourly compensation in manufacturing, which includes benefits, still exceeds that of the total private industry; however, the difference has narrowed significantly.
